lines: Beyond the black waves, the presence of morning can be felt.
An unfading star begins to shine in my chest.
Even a sad song will someday become a nostalgic song.
Even when I fall, I get up.
If I lose my way, I stop.
And I ask, if it were you,
In times like this, you would act.
At any time, no matter what.
Even on a road I thought I walked alone.
I think there were times I was carried away.
People are not merely living; they are being kept alive.
The sign standing at life's crossroads
No matter what I do or who I am with
Even on a road I must walk alone
At any time, no matter what.
Even on a road whose destination is still unknown
